name: ro-cinv-09stage-jitter
description: Candidate B ring, 9 stages: transient-noise period jitter and jitter accumulation at a fixed injected per-stage noise density.
tstep: 1p (print step; ngspice's own LTE and the trnoise breakpoints at vn_dt set the actual solver step)
noise_params: per-stage trnoise( NA=2.2361e-3 NT=1e-11 NALPHA=0 NAMP=0 ) -> injected white PSD 1e-16 V^2/Hz (1e-08 V/sqrt(Hz))
analyses: meas tran ts40 when v(xs40)=0 rise=5
meas tran ts60 when v(xs60)=0 rise=5
meas tran tk when v(xing)=0 rise=$&k
